milestones.name: ISF stabilisation programme
milestones.body: The agreement the Baran Council signed in December 1992. Quarterly reviews judge the deficit, inflation and, in time, the Bank's independence.

milestones.name: Concert association application
milestones.body: Ardenia's application to the Concert's association process is lodged. Admission is a decade away.

milestones.name: Concert association agreement
milestones.body: The agreement binds Ardenia to Concert rules on budgets and markets, and opens those markets in return.

milestones.name: Meridian partnership
milestones.body: Officers trained, exercises observed, no promises made.

milestones.name: Meridian security guarantee
milestones.body: An attack on Ardenia is now an attack on the alliance.

milestones.name: Krasovan Economic Union observer status
milestones.body: Ardenia hears the Union's plans and is asked for nothing yet.

milestones.name: Krasovan Economic Union membership
milestones.body: Open markets to the east, rescheduled debts, and a common tariff set in Krasova.

lines.isf_pass: The ISF mission signs off the quarterly review, and the next tranche is released.
lines.isf_fail: The ISF mission refuses to sign off the quarterly review. The tranche is suspended until terms are agreed.
